report.explanation: All checkout observations returned 200 with durations 78-344ms; gateway metrics show 13.3 checkout 200s and zero 502s in 60s. Traces show healthy downstream spans (inventory, payment, postgres, redis) with no errors. No evidence establishes any taxonomy cause; the alert's latency figures are within normal range. Handing off rather than asserting an unsupported fault.
missing_evidence: Evidence of actual checkout failures or elevated error rates (e.g., non-200 responses, 5xx) to substantiate http-500
Sustained latency measurements exceeding SLO thresholds to substantiate downstream-latency
DB connection pool saturation metrics (pool size/idle/wait) to substantiate db-pool-exhaustion
Redis timeout or error telemetry to substantiate redis-timeout
Chronological memory-retention series showing sustained growth to substantiate memory-leak
Configuration diff or validation errors to substantiate bad-configuration
